blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bahaghari, a gender identity advocacy group, has urged the government to strengthen its mechanisms against human trafficking and gender-based violence following the reported sexual exploitation of transgender minors in Navotas City. Eight individuals, four of whom were transgender individuals aged 15 to 16, were recently rescued by the National Bureau of Investigation
